title: pemex battles fresh gulf mexico oil leak 2026 09 12
text:
MEXICO CITY, Sept 11 (Reuters) - Pemex is working to contain a new crude oil leak from ​a pipeline at one of its Gulf ‌of Mexico facilities off Campeche, Mexico's Science Ministry said on Friday, in the latest spill to hit ​the state oil producer's aging offshore ​network.
The ministry said the leak was detected ⁠on Thursday morning. It expects the slick ​to drift westward in the coming days and, ​for now, does not forecast it reaching the coast.
